links.comparator_used: Professional human translation (linguist-produced) of discharge instructions in six languages
links.outcome: Linguist, clinician and family caregiver ratings of translation quality, preference, and translation time
links.effect: Human-in-the-loop (AI translation post-edited by linguists) was comparable or often better than professional translation in all languages; Armenian mean overall quality 3.9 [95% CI 3.7-4.2] vs 3.6 [3.4-3.9], p = 0.01; preferred 46.5% vs 28.4%; mean translation time 7.1 [5.4-8.8] vs 16.8 [13.7-19.9] min, p < 0.001
links.quote: Conversely, human-in-the-loop translations achieved comparable, often better, outcomes to professional translations for all languages, (e.g., Armenian mean overall quality: 3.9 [95% CI 3.7-4.2] vs. professional 3.6 [3.4-3.9], p = 0.01), were most frequently preferred (46.5% vs. 28.4%) and had shorter mean translation time (7.1 [5.4-8.8] vs. 16.8 [13.7-19.9] min, p < 0.001).

links.comparator_used: Unedited ChatGPT-4o translations released without professional linguist post-editing
links.outcome: Linguist, clinician and family caregiver Likert ratings of translation quality
links.effect: Unedited ChatGPT-4o performance was variable relative to professional translations, with the poorest ratings for Armenian and Somali; linguist post-edited (human-in-the-loop) translations were comparable or often better than professional translations in all languages (e.g., Armenian overall quality 3.9 vs professional 3.6). No direct numeric ChatGPT-vs-human-in-the-loop contrast is given in the abstract.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o exhibited variable performance relative to professional translations, with poorest ratings for digitally underrepresented languages (Armenian and Somali).
